newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to save 700 bln pta from rate cuts - Aznar.
newsitem.headline: Spain to save 700 bln pta from rate cuts - Aznar.

text.p: Spain will save more than 700 billion pesetas from 1996 through 1998 in financing public debt thanks to the declining trend in domestic interest rates, said Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said on Tuesday.
"The decline of interest rates will allow the Treasury to save more than 700 billion pesetas between 1996 and 1998", said Aznar opening a two-day Herald Tribune conference here in Madrid.
The Bank of Spain has cut its leading money market interest rate six times this year to the current 6.75 percent from nine percent at the start of the year.
From January to October, the Spanish Treasury spent 2.88 trillion pesetas in interest on public debt, up 17.2 percent from the same period in 1995 when it stood at 2.46 trillion pesetas.
